powers.name: Light Step
powers.summary: Each dot adds to Dexterity rolls and initiative. Spending blood at the start of a turn trades this bonus for extra actions (handled by the system).

system.description:
Example discipline with the “Swiftness” mechanical role. The blood quickens the body until the eye blurs.

The system applies its effects on its own: Dexterity and initiative bonus, movement speed, and, in combat, the offer at the start of each turn to spend blood for extra actions.

powers.name: Hard Skin
powers.summary: Each dot adds one soak die against all damage, aggravated included.

system.description: Example discipline with the “Resilience” mechanical role. The flesh hardens and refuses the wound.

powers.name: Grip
powers.summary: Each dot gives one automatic success on Strength rolls, including damage from blows and melee weapons.

system.description: Example discipline with the “Unnatural Might” mechanical role.

powers.name: Voice from the Threshold
powers.summary: The vampire makes their voice heard from a patch of shadow they can see, as if they stood there.

powers.name: Cloak of Soot
powers.summary: As long as they stay in the gloom and move no faster than a walk, they are noticed only by someone looking for them (Perception + Alertness, difficulty 8).

powers.name: Lantern Eye
powers.summary: They see through total darkness and can make out the warmth of the living.

powers.name: Dark Passage
powers.summary: They step into one shadow and out of another, visible and less than twenty meters away.

powers.name: Falling Night
powers.summary: Flames grow pale within ten meters; mortals present feel a dull dread (+1 difficulty to their rolls).

system.description: Example discipline with powers. Invented to show the editor: each power has its level, pool, difficulty, cost and duration. Click a power on the sheet to roll it.
Example of sorcery with paths. The parent discipline counts the dots; each path is a “discipline” item ticked “Sorcery path” that names it as its parent discipline.

powers.name: Spark
powers.summary: Lights a candle-sized flame on a visible object.

powers.name: Forge Heat
powers.summary: A metal object held in hand becomes scorching: whoever touches it takes 1 level of lethal damage per turn.

system.description: Example path tied to the Blood Art.
